findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
Observed spraying component in kitchen dish machine to have plastic pieces in the holes designed to dispense water during dish machine cycles. Remove plastic pieces from spraying component to ensure proper washing and sanitizing of food contact surfaces. 

4-501.11: (A) EQUIPMENT shall be maintained in good repair. (B) EQUIPMENT components shall be kept intact, tight, and adjusted to manufacturer’s specifications. (C) Cutting or piercing parts of can opens shall be kept sharp to minimize metal fragmentation.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed wet mop head to be stored head down in mop bucket. Store wet mop head in an inverted fashion to ensure drying.

6-501.16: After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.112: (A) Temperature of the fresh hot water SANITIZING rinse may not be more than 194F or less than 165F for stationary rack, single temperature machines. All other machines can be no less than 180F. (B) Maximum temperature does not apply to high pressure and temperature systems with wand-type spraying devices.
Observed that the dish machine thermometer is reading 154F and the maximum registering thermometer is reading 153F. The facility maintenance coordinator has been called to facilitate repairs.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
3-501.17: (A) Except for ROP, Refrigerated, RTE, TCS Food prepared and held in a food establishment for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date/maximum of 7 days. Day of preparation is Day 1 (Pf). (B) Date marking may not exceed manufacturer’s use-by date (Pf). (C) Combined portions of food shall retain the date marking of the earliest-prepared food (Pf). (D) Approved date marking systems (C). (E)  Does not apply to repacked from a bulk container (C). (F) Does not apply to shellstock (C).  (G) Exemptions: prepared deli salads prepared according to 21 CFR 110; hard cheeses (39% moisture); semi-soft cheeses (50% or less); cultured dairy products (yogurt, sour cream, buttermilk); preserved fish (pickled herring, dried/salted); dry, fermented sausages (pepperoni); and salt-cured products (prosciutto and parma).
Observed sliced cheese in the 3 door cooler to be undated. The Cheese was discarded. Practice proper date marking.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
4-202.16: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be free of unnecessary ledges, projections, and crevices, and designed and constructed to allow easy cleaning and to facilitate maintenance. 
Observed cardboard to be use on a dish rack to turn it into a shelf so that cans of cleaner did not fall over. Cardboard and dish rack were removed.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided. 
Employee states that there are no chlorine test strips. Test strips could not be found. Provide test strips.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Sanitizer bucket observed without any sanitizer concentration in red bucket. CORRECTED— PIC remade bucket to proper concentration.
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have a concentration of 50 to 200ppm. [P]
